name: gluetun
title: Gluetun
description: A VPN client in a container that other containers send their traffic through. Pick your provider (Mullvad, ProtonVPN, AirVPN, NordVPN, Private Internet Access and some 60 more), give it the WireGuard key or the OpenVPN login, and point an app at it: either with network_mode "service:gluetun" in that app's service (all of its traffic, with the app's ports published on Gluetun), or through the HTTP proxy on port 8888. When the tunnel drops, nothing leaves.

variables.name: GLUETUN_PROVIDER
variables.label: VPN provider
variables.description: The provider's name as Gluetun spells it: mullvad, protonvpn, airvpn, nordvpn, private internet access, surfshark, windscribe, custom …

variables.name: GLUETUN_WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.label: WireGuard private key
variables.description: From the WireGuard configuration your provider makes for you (PrivateKey = …). Leave empty with OpenVPN.

variables.name: GLUETUN_WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES
variables.label: WireGuard address
variables.description: The Address line of that configuration, for example 10.64.222.21/32. Leave empty with OpenVPN.

variables.name: GLUETUN_SERVER_COUNTRIES
variables.label: Countries
variables.description: Where the tunnel should come out, comma separated (Canada,Switzerland); empty lets the provider choose

variables.name: GLUETUN_LAN_SUBNETS
variables.label: Your network
variables.description: Lets your own network reach the apps behind the tunnel, for example 192.168.1.0/24; empty for none

variables.name: PORT_GLUETUN_PROXY
variables.label: HTTP proxy port
variables.description: Host port of the HTTP proxy
